lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate (2) to back flange (3), 90.1 deg. The line sits on the outer-skin apex at every 1 mm station. The nearest point is 0.01-0.24 mm away and the outer-apex w is about 0 (sections at 25/50/75% agree). Fold spans t=0..50.0, which the line covers end to end. Both ends stop at the closed box corners. The tilt bumps at t~13-15 and 39-41 come from the two extruded holes, not from bends.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Plate (2) to right flange (4), 91.4 deg. The line is on the outer apex across t=3..48.3 (nearest point 0.03-0.23 mm, apex w about 0). The 90 deg fold also continues over t=-4.0..0 into the toed-in free-end tab, which is not covered; there the apex sits up to 0.72 mm outside the straight line, still under 1 mm. Visible fold is 52.75 mm and the line covers 48.3 mm, so coverage is 92%. The far end stops at the B1 box corner.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Plate (2) to left flange (7), 90.4 deg. The line is on the outer apex across t=2..24.8 (nearest point 0.01-0.21 mm, apex w about 0). The region t=0..1.25 is where the free-end toe-in starts, and there the apex is 0.65-0.69 mm outside the line, under 1 mm. The 90 deg fold continues over t=-4.25..0 (the toed-in tab), which is not covered. Visible fold is 29.75 mm and the line covers 24.8 mm, so coverage is 83%: it passes the 80% rule, but only just. If the end tab is treated as its own bend segment, coverage of the straight fold is about 100%.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Plate (2) to notch-edge flange (10), 89.4 deg. The line is on the outer apex at every station (nearest point 0.02-0.33 mm, apex w -0.05..0.01). The fold spans t=-0.5..21.25 and the flange stops at a relief beyond that. The step in flange height (8 mm to about 4.5 mm) is not a bend. No in-plan kink was found along this flange (tilt below 0.2 deg).

missing_bends: Right flange (B2's flange, patch 4/5) free-end toe-in: the crease runs perpendicular to the base plate across the full flange height, at about t=0..1 from B2's label start, which is the free (open) end, roughly 4.5 mm from the flange end. The end tab is a flat facet (plane rms 0.004-0.015 mm) that turns inward by 10.4 deg (outer skin) / 10.36 deg (inner skin) relative to the main flange. It is the same on every height slice, and the plate edge under it follows the turn. The transition is about 2.5-3 mm wide (effective radius about 14 mm, much gentler than the brake bends' ri 1.5 mm). The original label excluded it as under 15 deg, which was the old rule. It is 10 deg or more, so it qualifies under the 2026-10-18 rule; it would not count only if judged a gentle rolled kink. Borderline.

Left flange (B3's flange, patch 7/8) free-end toe-in: same feature, mirrored, at about t=0..1 from B3's label start, roughly 4.3 mm from the flange end. Flat end tab turned inward by 10.6 deg (outer skin) / 11.2 deg (inner skin), transition about 2.5-3 mm. Same borderline call as the right flange: 10 deg or more, with planar facets on both sides. The original labeler excluded it only under the superseded 15 deg rule.
